integrity: A complete all-size proof is given with an independently rederived uniform-point covariance lemma. Exact small-n enumeration checks only the finite cases described; there is no claim of formal or independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves a reversal for every fixed n>=3, but not uniqueness or the location of zeros for general n; endpoint expansions are not uniform in n. Originality remains subject to independent historical-priority verification.
title: A universal inversion–cycle covariance reversal in Mallows permutations
